name: Bluesky (AT Protocol public API)

why.quote: Crawling the public parts of the API is allowed. HTTP 429 ("backoff") status codes are used for rate-limiting. Up to a handful concurrent requests should be ok.
why.basis: the API host's own robots.txt, which names crawling the public API as allowed; and the Terms of Service (https://bsky.social/about/support/tos, last updated 14 August 2025): "You retain ownership of your Content on the Bluesky application and website." (no reuse licence is given to others: each post stays its author's, so we store links and metadata only)

interface: AT Protocol public XRPC API (public.api.bsky.app) and firehose; open by design per the register brief.
notes: Read 18 Nov 2026 by data.b.collector@. Posts remain their authors' content under the Terms; we keep link and metadata only. Rate limits: https://docs.bsky.app/docs/advanced-guides/rate-limits (page is a client-side redirect; its text was not extractable).
how: Bluesky public AppView API, no login: https://public.api.bsky.app/xrpc/app.bsky.feed.getAuthorFeed, app.bsky.feed.searchPosts and app.bsky.actor.getProfiles, with our named user agent, 2.5 s between requests, organisations' accounts only (register/social-accounts.json). Post text read in memory only to match topics and places; never stored. Each post shown by link, credited, licence "the platform's terms".
